sat8.name: sat8
sat8.comment: WALKSAT, the local search of Selman, Kautz and Cohen, as Knuth implements it: it can find a model but never prove unsatisfiability.

sat9.name: sat9
sat9.comment: Survey propagation, the message passing method of the physicists: it answers only when its messages converge, and never proves unsatisfiability.
sat9.status_detail: Survey propagation reports that its messages did not converge on the instances of the suite, so it prints no answer; the method is incomplete by construction and never proves unsatisfiability.

sat11.name: sat11
sat11.status_detail: Lookahead solver that accepts unary, binary and ternary clauses only, as it says itself; it answers correctly on the 3-SAT instance of the suite and refuses its pigeonhole instance, whose clauses are longer.

sat11k.name: sat11k
sat11k.status_detail: The change file sat11k.ch no longer matches the sat11.w that Stanford serves today: ctangle reports one hunk that fails to match, so the program would be built from a partially applied change.

sat12.name: sat12
sat12.status_detail: Not a solver but a preprocessor, as its own introduction says: it simplifies the clauses and writes the reduced formula, so it prints no answer.
